_comment: wf-fake scripts for the review-gate corpus scenario (WF-347 / WF-313). Synthetic host fake.local and FAKE- ids only — no external delivery host, no network. Scripts the review-thread ops (WF-324) the five WF-313 requirements exercise: an ordered checks-read poll (PENDING then SUCCESS = requirement 2), an ordered review-threads-read (first read-performed:false = a not-yet-landed poll resolving to UNKNOWN not clean, then read-performed:true at HEAD_SHA = requirement 1), a zero-files-reviewed pr-comments-read (requirement 3), and reply/resolve responses (requirements 4 and 5). See items/review-gate/item.md for the requirement->op map.
